要 means need or main point: to need, to require.
避 means avoid: よける is to step aside and dodge something.
From 汚れる (to get dirty): dirty water (氵), dirt or a stain.
From 果てる (to end): the very end, the far edge.
光 means light, as in 日光 (sunlight) and 観光 (sightseeing).
Plant (艹) + enjoy (楽): plants that make you feel good, medicine, as in 胃腸薬.
Present (現) + ground (地): the actual place where it happens, local.
Match (合) + mind (意): minds that match, agreement.
察 means observe: to read the situation and guess what someone feels.
Mixed (雑) + talk (談): talk about this and that, chatting.
Thing (事) + business (業): a business or big project.
Decide (決) + calculate (算): the final calculation of the accounts.
Decide (決) + win (勝): the match that decides the winner, the final.
Put up (登) + record (録): putting your name on the record, registering.
Take (取り) + replace (替え): taking one out and putting another in, a swap.
Back (背) + behind (後): right behind your back.
Abolish (廃) + stop (止): stopping something for good.
One (一) + breath (気): all in one breath, in one go.
Earth (土) + village (里): covering with earth, to bury.
From 訴える (to sue, to complain): words (言) taken to court, a complaint.
Plum (梅) + dried (干し): a dried pickled plum.
及 means reach: a hand catching the person ahead, to reach or extend.
Meet (会) + see (見): meeting people to be seen, a press conference.
Stubborn (頑) + hard (固): hard headed, stubborn.
Technique (技) + ability (能): technical skill.
Business (業) + duty (務): work duties.
Same (同) + grade (級): the same class, as in 同級生 (classmate).
Way (道) + place (場): a place to learn the way, a dojo.
From 争う (to fight over): a fight or dispute.
Say (言い) + reason (訳): saying your reasons, an excuse.
Job (職) + member (員): a staff member.
New (新) + marriage (婚): newly married.
Judge (審) + investigate (査): judging and checking, an examination.
Blow (吹) + play music (奏): playing by blowing, wind instruments, as in 吹奏楽.
Explain (説) + gain (得): explaining until you win them over, persuasion.
Only (専) + use (用): for one use or person only, exclusive.
Send (送) + money (金): sending money.
Plain (素) + simple (朴): plain and simple.
Body (体) + power (力): physical strength.
Fixed (定) + meal (食): a fixed set meal.
Point (指) + pick (摘): picking out a problem and pointing to it.
Take (取) + material (材): gathering material for a story.
Main (主) + person (人) + lord (公): the lord of the story, the main character.
Go to (赴) + duty (任): going to a new post.
Writing (文) + write (書): written papers, a document.
Repay (償): paying back for something you broke or lost.
Root (本) + nature (質): the root nature of something, its essence.
Show (見せ) + thing (物): a thing to show, a show or spectacle.
See (見) + pile up (積もり): looking and adding up the costs, an estimate.
Duty (役) + place (場): the place where officials work, the town hall.
Side (横) + rope (綱): the thick rope worn around the waist of the sumo grand champion.
Finish (了) + understand (解): fully understood, roger that.
Person (亻) on the left: a rough, manly word for "I".
故 means late or old: 故山田さん is the late Mr. Yamada.
Samurai (士) + heart (心): a samurai's heart set on a goal, ambition.
Hand (手) at the bottom: the palm of your hand.
Grass (艹) on top: short grass, a lawn, as in 芝生.
Go (行) around it: streets, a town area, as in 商店街 (shopping street).
界 means boundary: a world inside one boundary, like 芸能界, the entertainment world.
Make the image (像) appear (現): developing film so the picture shows up.
The original (原) rule (則): the basic rule everything starts from.
Buy (購) and bring in (入): you purchase something and take it home.
Tell (告) it plainly (白, clear): a confession of the truth or of love.
Tiny (細) germs (菌): bacteria too small to see.
Appear (現) again (再): reproducing a scene so it happens again.
Pick (採) and choose (択): officially adopting one option from many.
Pick (採) for use (用): adopting an idea or hiring a person.
Shave (削) and decrease (減): cutting costs or numbers down.
Make (作) use (用): the way something works on another thing, its effect.
Examine (討) and argue (論): a debate.
Go a far (遠) way round (回り): taking the long detour.
研 means polish: you sharpen a knife by polishing it on a stone.
A person (亻) at your half (半) side: something that comes along with you.
Take (取) and pull (引): goods and money move both ways in a business deal.
Take (取り) it back (戻す): to get back what you lost.
Grass (艹) over a rice field (田): a young rice seedling.
No (ない) feeling (気) of anything (何) behind it: done casually, without thinking.
Day (日) and night (夜): all the time.
値 means value: 値打ち is how much something is really worth.
Pull (引き) the price (値) down: a discount.
A sword (刀) with an extra mark on its sharp edge: the blade.
Spread (配) your thoughts (慮) to others: care and consideration.
One (一) rule (律) for all: uniform, the same for everyone.
A plan (図) in your mind (意): your intention. Sounds a bit like "intent".
Now (今), after things have gone further (更): "it is too late now".
受 means receive: the school receives you, so you pass the exam.
Receive (受け) and put in (入れる): to accept someone or something.
Big (大) width (幅): a large, drastic change.
Fall (落ち) deep in (込む): your mood drops and you feel down.
訪 is words (言) + direction (方): you go in someone's direction to talk, you visit.
Renew (改) and remake (革): a big reform.
Go around (回) and gather (収): collecting things back.
House (家) calculations (計): the family budget.
傍 is a person (亻) at the side: beside, or doing something on the side.
Feel (感) by touch (触): how something feels to your hand.
Liver (肝) and heart (心), the vital organs: the most important thing.
Air (気) phenomena (象): the weather.
Turn (転) the opposite (逆) way: a reversal, a comeback.
Stuck (窮) and bent over (屈): tight and cramped, no room to move.
Carrying out (行) government (政): administration.
Empty (空) gap (間): space.
Neck (首) ring (輪): a collar, or a necklace.
The same (同) feeling (情) as someone: sympathy.
Resource (資) money (金): funds.
Thing (事) item (項): items or matters on a list.
Before (前) the thing (事): in advance.
Proof (証) in words (言): testimony.
Feeling (情) threads (緒): emotions and the mood of a place.
Feeling (情) threads (緒): emotions and mood; じょうしょ is the older reading of じょうちょ.
Win (勝) and profit (利): a victory.
The place (所) where it exists (在): whereabouts.
Person (人) material (材): the talented people a company needs.
Control (制) and promise (約): limits you must work within.
切 means cut: a feeling so sad it cuts your heart.
攻 means attack: 攻め is the offence, the attacking side.
Proclaim (宣) in words (言): a declaration.
Set opposite (対) and compare (比): a contrast.
Store (蓄) and pile up (積): accumulation.
Long (長) compilation (編): a long novel or film.
Arrange (調) properly (理): cooking food.
Light (軽) in the hand (手): easy and simple.
Hands (手) handed out (配): arranging people and things; also a police search.
A book (本) for your hand (手) to copy: a model to follow.
Connected (連) rest days (休): a run of holidays.
Your original (元) ground (地): your local area, your home town.

Idea (意) + see (見): how you see an idea, your opinion.

Meeting (会議) + room (室): the room for meetings.

Eat (食) + thing (事): the act of eating, a meal.

Travel (旅) + building (館): a building for travellers, a Japanese inn.

Skill (技) + method (術): skills and methods, technique or technology.

Pass through (経) + test (験): the tests you passed through, experience.

Mud (泥) + stick (棒): a muddy man with a stick, a thief.

Learn (習) + get used to (慣): something learned until you are used to it, a custom.

View (景) + colour (色): the colours of the view, scenery.

Back (背) + middle (中): the middle of your back.

Introduce (紹) + go between (介): going between two people, an introduction.

Woman (女) + good (良): a good young woman, a daughter.

Leftover (残) + feeling (念): a feeling that stays behind, regret.

Plan (案) + inside (内): leading people inside with a plan, guidance.

Shape (形): the outer form of something.
Water (氵) + street (巷): the place where water meets the streets, a harbour.

University (大学) + student (生): a university student.
Time (時) + generation (代): a time of one generation, an era.

Origin (原) + cause (因): where it all came from, the cause.
Company (社) + meeting (会): people meeting in groups, society.
A bird (鳥) on a mountain (山) in the sea: an island.
Sun (日) + born (生): little suns born in the sky, stars.
Festival (祭): a celebration for the gods, a festival.
Receive (受) + attach (付): where visitors are received and signed in, reception.

Wear (着) + thing (物): the thing you wear, a kimono.

Pass through (歴) + record (史): a record of what passed, history.
Rice field (田) + cottage (舎): cottages by the fields, the countryside.

Newspaper (新聞) + company (社): a newspaper company.

Neck (首): also means head, the part that holds up your head.
Route (途) + middle (中): in the middle of the route, on the way.
Driving (運転) + hand (手): the hands on the wheel, a driver.

Small (小) + learning (学) + school (校): the school for small kids, elementary school.

Finger (指) + circle (輪): the circle you wear on your finger, a ring.

Interest (趣) + taste (味): something you have a taste for, your hobby.

Correct, first (正) + month (月): the first month of the year, New Year.
Red (赤) + ちゃん: newborns look red, so the baby is the little red one.
Parent, close (親) + keen (切): caring keenly like a parent, kindness.
Fire (火) + matter (事): a fire matter, a house on fire.
One (一) + cup (杯): one cupful, so 'full' or 'a lot'.
Not (不) + convenient (便): inconvenient.
General (普) + pass through (通): what passes everywhere is normal, usual.

World (世) + talk (話): talking with and helping people in your world, looking after them.
Special (特) + separate (別): set apart from the rest, special.

Law (法) + rule (律): laws and rules, the law.

Sleep (寝) + boy (坊): a lazy little boy who sleeps in late.

Cross (交) + pass through (通): people crossing and passing, traffic.

厳 means stern or severe (it has a cliff 厂): strict, hard.
Water radical (氵): deep water, deep.
Words (言) + all around (周): check words from all sides, to look up.

Water (氵) + stand (立): standing there with water in your eyes, to cry.

Earth (土) radical: earth piled up more and more, to increase.
選 as in 選手 (chosen player) and 選挙 (election): to choose.
Foot radical (⻊): moving your feet, a dance.
Pull (引き) + out (出し): the thing you pull out, a drawer.
City (市) + people (民): people of the city, citizens.
Stay (留) + guard (守): someone stays to guard the house while you are away.
Craft (工) + place (場): a place where things are made, a factory.
Rain (雨) on top: the thing rain comes from, a cloud.
員 means member, as in 会社員 (company member) and 店員 (shop staff).
受 shows one hand passing something to another hand: to receive, to take (an exam).
Spirit (気) + part (分): the part of your spirit right now, your mood.
Beauty (美) + art (術) + building (館): a building for beautiful art, an art museum.

通 (pass through, as in 交通): pass along the same road again and again, to commute.
Sky (空) + port (港): a port for the sky, an airport.
All (都) + fit (合): when everything fits, it is convenient for you.
Push (押し) + put in (入れ): the cupboard you push your futon into.

Dangerous (危) + steep (険): steep and dangerous, danger.
Day (日) + write down (記): writing down each day, a diary.
Calm, safe (安) + heart (心): a calm heart, relief.
Birds (隹) gathering on a tree (木): to collect, to gather.

Door (戸) over 大 (once 犬, dog): the dog comes back to the door, to return.
Enter (入) + road (⻌): everyone enters the road, so it is crowded.
Metal radical (金): old mirrors were polished metal.
Water radical (氵); みずうみ is water (水) + sea (海): a water sea, a lake.
Moment (機) + meet (会): the moment when you meet it, a chance.
Not (非) over heart (心): your heart says no, sad.
届 means to reach: you make the package reach someone, to deliver.
Hurry (急) + go (行): a train that hurries, an express.
Daytime (昼) + interval (間): the time during the day.
済 means settle, finish (as in 経済): the matter gets settled, it ends.
Noon (昼) + rest (休み): the noon rest, lunch break.
Number (数) + study (学): the study of numbers, maths.
Flower (花) + look (見): looking at the cherry flowers.

Stone (石) + little (少): little stones, sand.

Sell (売り) + place (場): the selling place, a sales counter.

決 means decide (as in 決して): to decide.

踊 has a foot (足): move your feet to dance.
塗 has water (氵) and earth (土): spread mud on a wall, to paint or plaster.
Public (公) + duty (務) + member (員): a member who does public work.
嬢 has woman (女): a young woman, someone's daughter.
Erase (消し) + rubber (ゴム, from Dutch gom): the rubber that erases.
Sea (海) + shore (岸): the coast.
Ride (乗り) + thing (物): a thing you ride, a vehicle.
Small (小) bird (鳥): a little bird.
Lower (下) + lodging (宿): a humble place to stay, a boarding house.
貿 has a shell (貝, old money) + exchange (易): swapping goods for money, trade.
申 means to say humbly: 申す is the humble way to say 言う.
亡 means dead, gone: a person is gone, passed away.
足 is foot, but also enough: add more until it is enough.
Teach (教) + meeting (会): a meeting where faith is taught, a church.
暮 has the sun (日) under grass (艹): the sun sinks into the grass, it gets dark.
Middle (中) and middle again (々), deeper and deeper in: quite, very; with a negative, not easily.
Lecture (講) + hall (堂): a hall for lectures, an auditorium.
Under (下) + wear (着): underwear.
Right (是) or wrong (非), whatever happens: by all means.
Branch (支) + measure (度): sort and measure things ahead, getting ready.
Big (大) body (体): the big body of it, roughly, in general.
Transport (輸) + enter (入): goods carried in, import.
Produce (産) + business (業): producing business, industry.
Special (特) + hurry (急): the special fast train.
Lecture (講) + meaning (義): explaining meanings, a lecture.
Warm (暖) + room (房): heating.
慣 has a heart (忄): your heart gets used to it.
Child (子) with polite お and さん: someone else's child.
Display (展) + look (覧) + meeting (会): an event to look at displays, an exhibition.
召 means summon: 召し上がる is the respectful way to say someone eats or drinks.
Pour (注) + shoot (射): shoot medicine into you, an injection.
冷 has ice (冫): it grows cold.
割 has a knife (刂): it splits, it breaks.
Craft, factory (工) + business (業): manufacturing industry.
汚 has water (氵): dirty water, to become dirty.
True (真) + middle (中): the exact middle, the center.
This (この) time (頃): these days.
Watch (看) + protect (護) + woman (婦): a woman who watches over patients, a nurse.
See (見) + things (物): going to see things, sightseeing.
陰 means shade: in someone's shade (protection), thanks to them.
Tree (木) + cotton (綿): cotton from a plant, read もめん.
Transport (輸) + go out (出): goods sent out, export.
Big (大) part (分): a large part, quite a lot.
Electric (電) + report (報): a message by wire, a telegram.
Inside (内) the house (家): an old word for one's wife, who keeps the home.
億 has a person (亻): more people than you can imagine, a hundred million.
製 has clothes (衣): clothes made in a place, made in ~.
軒 means the edge of a roof: count houses by their roofs.
区 is a box (匚) with a mark inside: a section of a city, a ward.
絹 has thread (糸): fine thread from silkworms, silk.
Study (学) + part (部): the part of a university for one study, a faculty.
御 shows respect: put ご (or お) before a word to make it polite.
踏 has a foot (足): put your foot down, step on.
盗 has a dish (皿): someone takes from your dish, steals.
沸 has water (氵): the water bubbles up, it boils.
折 has a hand (扌) and axe (斤): snap a branch by hand or axe, break or fold.
柔 has a tree (木): young branches bend easily, soft.
過 has the road part (辶): go past on the road, to pass or exceed.
揺 has a hand (扌): a hand shakes it, it sways.
落 has grass (艹) and water (氵): leaves fall into the water, to fall.
致 means to bring about: the humble way to say する, いたします.
噛 has a mouth (口) and teeth (歯): bite and chew.
Say humbly (申し) + raise up (上げる): humbly offer your words up to someone.
寄 has a roof (宀): drop by under someone's roof.
包 is a baby wrapped up inside: to wrap.
無 means nothing: it becomes nothing, it disappears.
痩 has the sickness part (疒): sick people get thin, lose weight.
漬 has water (氵): put it in liquid to soak or pickle.
乾 has the sun (日) inside: the sun makes things dry.
連 has a vehicle (車) on the road (辶): carts in a line, take someone along.
楽 means fun: to have fun, to enjoy.
Hold out (差し) + raise up (上げる): humbly hold a gift up to someone.
凄 has ice (冫): so great it gives you chills.
写 means copy: copy a picture, take a photo.
釣 has metal (金): a metal hook to catch fish.
叱 has a mouth (口): use your mouth to scold.
沸 has water (氵): make the water boil.
折 has a hand (扌) and axe (斤): the branch gets snapped, it breaks or bends.
滑 has water (氵) and bone (骨): wet bones slip, to slide.
All mean hard: 堅 has earth (土), 硬 has stone (石), 固 is shut in a box (囗).
騒 has a horse (馬): excited horses make lots of noise.
High (高) + school (校): high school, short for 高等学校.
似 has a person (亻): one person looks like another.
褒 has clothes (衣): give someone fine robes to praise them.
見 means see: someone sees it, it is found.
太 is big (大) plus a dot: get bigger, gain weight.
直 means straight: it is made straight again, fixed.
焼 has fire (火): it burns or gets roasted.
点 has fire (灬) at the bottom: the light comes on.
落 has grass (艹) and water (氵): leaves drop into the water, to drop.
回 is a box turning inside a box: to go around, to turn.
濡 has water (氵) and rain (雨): you get wet.
倒 has a person (亻): a person falls down, collapses.
Take (取り) + change (替える): take one out, put another in, replace.
参 means to visit (a shrine): humbly go or come.
Ride (乗り) + change (換える): change trains or buses.
集 is a bird (隹) on a tree (木): birds gather.
The kanji 人 looks like a person walking on two legs.
One single line (一) means one.
何 was first drawn as a person (亻) carrying a load: "What is that?" (なに).
A tree (木) with a mark at its base: the root or origin, and also a book.
少 means few or little: just a little scoop (すこ) of rice.
A line going through the middle of a box: 中 is the inside or middle.
手 looks like a hand with fingers spread; "te" like the start of "ten fingers".
Words (言) from the tongue (舌): talking, telling a story.
Time (時) + interval (間): a span of time.
Meet (会) + company (社): a place where people meet to work, a company.
A roof (宀) over a pig (豕): in old China the home kept pigs under the roof.
前 means front or before: "Ma, eh? Look in front!"
Born (生) before (先) you: the person who knows more, your teacher.
Serve (仕) + matter (事): the things you do to serve, your job.
今 means now: "I'm a" student now (いま).
私 means private, myself: I keep my own rice plant (禾) private.
Same kanji 私 (private, I), but the longer reading わたくし is the extra polite "I".
Section (部) + roof or house (屋): a section of the house, a room.
Electric (電) + vehicle (車): an electric train.
年 means year; the years you have lived are your age (とし).
Now (今) + day (日): the day that is now, today (special reading きょう).
A building (广) where goods are shown: 店 is a shop; "me, see" the shop (みせ).
Stand (立) by a tree (木) and cut it with an axe (斤): fresh, new wood.
A woman (女) with her child (子): the love she feels, liking.
上 is a line pointing up from the ground: above, on top.
Bright (明) + day (日): the next bright day, tomorrow (special reading あした).
十 is a cross, like the Roman X for ten.
Ten (十) when counting things: ひとつ, ふたつ, up to とお, the only one with no つ.
Electric (電) + talk (話): talking by electricity, the telephone.
Two lines (二) for two; you have two knees (に).
Self (自) + part (分): your own part, oneself.
後 means behind or after: what comes after, later.
Materials (料) + logic (理): putting ingredients together with skill, cooking.
先 means ahead: the place ahead of you, or the time before.
車 looks like a cart from above, a wheel on an axle: it comes (くる) rolling.
Copy (写) + truth (真): a true copy of what you see, a photo.
One (一) + person (人): one person, alone (special reading ひとり).
Every (毎) + day (日): every day.
行 was drawn as a crossroads: you go out onto the road.
父 shows hands holding a tool: the hard working father.
A person (亻) resting by a tree (木): rest, a day off.
Hand (手) + paper (紙): paper you write by hand, a letter.
The sun rising in the grass while the moon (月) is still out: morning.
Under a roof (亠), a person (亻) and the evening moon (夕): night.
Study (学) + life (生): a person whose life is study, a student.
Effort (勉) + strong (強): working hard and strong, studying.
母 is a woman with two dots for breasts: mother. "Ha ha," laughs mum.
One (一) + number or turn (番): number one, the best.
House (家) + tribe (族): the group in one house, your family.
女 looks like a woman kneeling with crossed arms: woman.
Three lines (三) for three; "sun" sounds like さん.
金 means gold or money; お makes it polite: money.
An ox (牛) on the left: an ox was a valuable thing, an object.
The horse (馬) on the left: stations were where travellers changed horses.
Study (学) + school (校): a place for study, a school.
One (一) thing: ひとつ, counting objects with つ.
Two (二) + person (人): two people (special reading ふたり).
雨 shows drops falling from a cloud: rain. "Ah, meh," rain again.
Say (言) + leaf (葉): words fall from your mouth like leaves.
山 looks like three mountain peaks.
Name (名) + before (前): the name you say before anything else.
大 is a person with arms stretched wide: big.
小 is a thing split into tiny parts: small, little.
日 is the sun: one sun is one day, so 日 counts days and dates.
同 means same: one mouth (口) under one cover, all saying the same thing.
Ten (十) + mouth (口): a story passed through ten mouths is old.
木 looks like a tree with branches and roots.
Big (大) + study (学): big study, a university.
近 has the road part (辶): only a short road to go, nearby.
Big (大) + cut (切): something that cuts deep into your heart is important.
Sun (日) + weekday (曜日): the sun's day, Sunday.
Previous (昨) + day (日): the day before, yesterday (special reading きのう).
Every (毎) + morning (朝): every morning.
Question (問) + topic (題): a question topic, a problem.
大 is a person with arms stretched wide to show something big.
Origin (本) + hit (当): it hits the true origin, real.
方 means direction or way: a polite way to point to a person, or a way of doing.
The thread (糸) part: paper was made from fibres.
One (一) + cord (緒): tied by one cord, together.
Blue (青) + fight (争): the fight turns calm and blue, quiet.
Whole (全) + part (部): all the parts, everything.
Rice field (田) + street (丁): fields with streets become a town.
Upper (上) + hand (手): having the upper hand, skillful.
目 is an eye turned on its side; "me" sees with my eyes.
Journey (旅) + go (行): going on a journey, a trip.
Clothing (衤) + knife (刀): cutting the cloth is the first step, the first time.
Refine (練) + learn (習): learning by doing it again and again, practice.
下 is a line pointing down from a bar: below, under.
来 means come: "Come!" sounds a bit like くる.
New (新) + hear (聞): new things you hear about, the newspaper.
Head (首) + road (辶): the road your head leads you along, the way.
Door (戸) + axe (斤): the place where you keep your tools, a place.
人 (person) read じん after a country: 日本人 is a Japanese person.
人 (person) read にん when counting: 三人 is three people.
高 looks like a tall tower: tall, high, and a high price.
One (一) + day (日): one whole day, read いちにち.
One (一) + day (日), the first of the month: from つきたち, the moon (月) starts.
Origin (元) + spirit (気): your basic energy, healthy and lively.
言 is a mouth (口) with words coming out: to say.
Coming (来) + week (週): next week.
Field (田) + power (力): the one using power in the field, a man.
若 has grass (艹) on top: a fresh new sprout, young.
Head (頁) on the right: the front of your head, the face.
Two strokes (二 shape) + yawn (欠): yawning while you wait, you are next.
Reflect (映) + picture (画): pictures shown on a screen, a movie.
茶 has grass (艹) on top for tea leaves; "cha" like chai tea.
Self (自) + turn (転) + vehicle (車): a vehicle you turn yourself, a bicycle.
見 is an eye (目) on legs (儿): going to look, to see.
Evening (夕) + fortune telling (卜): fortunes were told at night, outside.
外 means outside: things outside this one are the others (ほか).
声 means voice: think of a choir voice singing "koe".
Tree (木) + measure (寸): a small place among the trees, a village.
小 shows a thing split into tiny bits: small.
Friend (友) + plural (達): your friends.
五 means five: "go" count to five on one hand.
Time (時) + measure (計): a thing that measures time, a clock.
多 is two evenings (夕夕) stacked up: many nights, many.
Sky (天) + air (気): what the air in the sky is like, the weather.
Idea (意) + taste (味): the taste of an idea, its meaning.
Sick (病) + institution (院): the place for sick people, a hospital.
Public (公) + garden (園): a public garden, a park.
Noon (午) + after (後): after noon, P.M.
Drawing (図) + writing (書) + building (館): a building for books, a library.
Mother (母) with polite お and さん: mum, said with respect.
窓 has a hole (穴) on top: a hole in the wall, a window.
Wealth (財) + cloth (布): a cloth holder for your money, a wallet.
Electric (電) + energy (気): electricity, and the electric light.
Sick (病) + spirit (気): a sick spirit, illness.
帰 means return: like a frog (カエル) going back to its pond, you go home (かえる).
寒 has a roof (宀) with ice (冫) at the bottom: cold even inside.
春 has the sun (日) at the bottom: the sun warms the plants in spring.
Tie (結) + marriage (婚): tying the knot, getting married.
寝 has a roof (宀) and a bed (丬) inside: lying down to sleep.
風 has an insect (虫) inside a frame: bugs blown by the wind.
An ear (耳) at the gate (門): listening at the gate, to hear.
Field (野) + greens (菜): greens from the field, vegetables.
Water (氵) + every (毎): water everywhere, the sea.
Han China (漢) + character (字): Chinese characters.
Teach (教) + room (室): a room for teaching, a classroom.
Earth (土) + weekday (曜日): 土星 is Saturn, so it is Saturday.
Words (言) + tongue (舌): using your tongue for words, to speak.
空 means sky or empty: a hole (穴) with nothing in it, the empty sky.
Medicine (医) + person (者): a person of medicine, a doctor.
Scatter (散) + walk (歩): walking around freely, a stroll.
Words (言) + bird (隹): you call out to the bird, "Who's there?"
Grass (艹) + change (化): a plant that changes into a flower.
水 looks like water splashing out from a central stream.
Moon (月) + weekday (曜日): the moon's day, Monday.
The sun (日) seen through a tree (木): the sun rises in the east.
Coming (来) + month (月): next month.
A border (囗) around a jewel (玉): a protected country.
白 is the sun (日) with a ray on top: bright white light.
出 means out, like 出口 (exit): you take things out or hand them in (だす).
長 was drawn as an old man with long hair: long.
Every (毎) + evening (晩): every night.
Child (子) + companion (供): children.
Person (亻) + move (動): a person moving about, to work.
Coming (来) + year (年): next year.
Second rate (亜) over a heart (心): a bad heart, bad.
Now (今) + year (年): this year (special reading ことし).
夏 means summer: the summer heat drives you "nuts" (なつ).
入 looks like a tent entrance: "Hi, I'm in!" (はいる), to enter.
Sun (日) + escape (免): when the sun escapes, it is evening.
Have (有) + name (名): to have a name, famous.
Person (亻) + origin (本): the base of a person, the body.
何 (what) + a counter: 何人 how many people, 何時 what time.
歌 has an open mouth (欠): opening your mouth wide to sing a song.
書 has a hand holding a brush (聿) at the top: to write.
Wind (風) + evil (邪): an evil wind gives you a cold; same sound as wind.
Two (二) things: ふたつ.
難 has a bird (隹): catching a bird is difficult.
本 is a tree (木) with a mark, so it counts long thin things like pens.
Gold or metal (金) + weekday: 金星 is Venus, so it is Friday.
暑 has the sun (日) on top: hot weather.
Gone (去) + year (年): the year that has gone, last year.
Lodging (宿) + topic (題): topics you take home, homework.
作 has a person (亻) on the left: a person making something.
A woman (女) under a roof (宀) is at peace (安): cheap prices give peace of mind.
弟 shows a rope wound in order: the brother who comes after you.
口 looks like an open mouth.
四 is a box (囗) with four sides; し also sounds like death, so people often say よん.
England (英) + language (語): the English language.
Give (授) + work (業): the work of giving lessons, a class.
Summer (夏) + rest (休み): summer vacation.
Load (荷) + thing (物): things you carry, luggage.
Silver (銀) + business (行): the business that holds your silver, a bank.
痛 has the sickness part (疒): when you are sick, it hurts. "Itai!"
弁当 is a boxed lunch, the "bento box"; お makes it polite.
Sweep (掃) and remove (除) the dirt: that is cleaning.
犬 is 大 (big) with a dot, like a dog's ear. "Eee-noo!" the dog barks.
買 has 貝 (shell, old money) at the bottom: you pay shells to buy. "Ka-ching" sounds like かう.
食 is a lid over a food bowl. "Tah-bay!" you say as you sit down to eat.
Three (三) days (日), or the 3rd of the month. Say "mikka", not "san nichi".
Cold (冷) storage (蔵) building (庫): the box that keeps food cold, a fridge.
猫 has the animal side 犭 plus 苗. A cat says "meow", the Japanese cat is "ne-ko".
丈夫 is a tall (丈) grown man (夫): strong and solid, hard to break.
時 is sun (日) plus temple (寺): the temple bell tells the time. 3時 is three o'clock.
Same 時 (time) read とき: "at the time when", like 子どもの時 (when I was a child).
A big (大) person (人): an adult. Special reading: おとな.
A book (書) of words (辞): a dictionary.
The day (日) you were born (誕 and 生 both mean birth): your birthday.
夕 is evening, 方 is direction or time: the evening side of the day, late afternoon.
中 (middle) read じゅう means all through: 一日中 is the whole day long.
中 (middle) read ちゅう means in the middle of doing: 食事中 is during a meal.
頭 has 頁 (head) on the right. "A tama" (a ball) sits on your shoulders: your head.
兄 is a big mouth (口) on legs (儿): the older brother who talks loudly. "Ani" = big bro.
赤 grew from big (大) plus fire (火): the red of a big fire. "Aka" like a red "ah, car!"
Sound (音) that is fun (楽): music.
質 is quality or nature, 問 is to ask: asking about the nature of something, a question.
A big (大) change (変): very much, or a hard, terrible situation.
使 has a person (亻) on the left: a person you send to do a job, so to use.
雪 has rain (雨) on top: rain that falls frozen is snow. "You key" in the snow.
Buy (買い) things (物): shopping.
白 is the sun (日) with a ray of light on top: bright white. "Shiro" sounds like "show" white.
A big (大) strong man (丈夫) says: it's fine, I'm OK.
嫌 has woman (女) on the left. "Kill ray!" you shout at something you hate.
The stand (台) place (所) in the house where you cook: the kitchen.
誰 means who, plus か (some): "who-some", someone.
Every (毎) week (週).
読 has words (言) on the left: you take in words when you read. "Yo, moo!" says a cow reading a book.
前 means front or before: 駅の前 is in front of the station.
赤 (red, from big fire) plus い makes the adjective: red.
青 has life (生) on top: the blue green of young plants. "Ao" like a blue "ah, oh" sky.
昼 has the sun (日) in it: the time when the sun is highest, noon and daytime.
便 is handy or transport, 利 is benefit: easy to use and useful, convenient.
服 means clothes. "Fuku": you fold your fuku (clothes) every night.
青 (blue, green of young plants) plus い makes the adjective: blue.
酒 has water (氵) and a jar (酉): liquid from a jar, sake. お makes it polite.
強 has a bow (弓) on the left: pull a bow hard, strong. "Tsuyoi" sounds tough.
百 is one (一) on top of white (白): hundred. "Hyaku!" like a big cheer for 100.
色 is color. "Iro" sounds like "I roll" paint of every color.
魚 is a picture of a fish: head, body with scales, and tail (灬). "Saka-na" swims in the sea.
七 looks like an upside down 7 with a cross. "Shichi" (seven), also なな.
父 (father) with polite お and さん: your dad, said with respect.
A child (子) who is a woman (女): a girl.
Water (水) day (曜日): Wednesday, named after the water planet Mercury.
晴 has the sun (日) next to blue (青): sun in a blue sky, clear weather.
降 means to come down: rain and snow come down, they fall. "Fu-ru" like falling rain.
箱 has bamboo (竹) on top: a box made of bamboo. "Hako" sounds like "hack open" the box.
机 has tree (木) on the left: a wooden desk. "Tsukue" is where you sit and work.
開 shows two doors (門) being pushed open. You open (あける) something yourself.
忙 is heart (忄) plus lose (亡): so busy you lose your heart. "Isogashii" = so busy.
後 means behind or after. "Ushiro": the place at your back.
傘 is a picture of an umbrella: a cover with people (人) under it. "Kasa" keeps you dry.
Lower (下) hand (手): your hand skill is low, you are bad at it. Special reading へた.
休 is a person (亻) leaning on a tree (木): taking a rest.
年 means year: 三年 is three years. "Nen" counts years.
絵 has thread (糸) on the left, like an old picture woven in cloth: a picture. Just "e".
出 looks like a plant coming out of a box: to go out, to leave, to appear. "Deru" = exit.
隣 means next to. "Tonari" sounds like "to nearly" touch: the one right next door.
半 is a thing cut down the middle: half. 二時半 is half past two.
分 is a knife (刀) dividing: an hour divided into minutes. Sound changes: 一分 いっぷん, 三分 さんぷん.
Before (前) noon (午): morning, A.M.
洗 (wash) and 濯 (rinse), both with water (氵): washing clothes, the laundry.
Big (大) like (好き): to like something very much, to love it.
取 is an ear (耳) and a hand (又): in old wars soldiers took ears. To take or get.
薬 is grass (艹) over fun or ease (楽): plants that make you feel better, medicine.
会 means to meet: people come together under one roof. "Au": "ow!" when you bump into a friend.
奥 means the inside, the back of the house: the wife who runs the inner house. Polite さん.
Outside (外) country (国): a foreign country, abroad.
八 is two lines spreading apart, like eight's shape opening. "Hachi" (eight).
近 has the moving road part (辶): only a short walk away, near. "Chikai" = close.
A moving (動) thing (物): an animal.
黒 has fire (灬) at the bottom: the black soot over a fire. "Kuro" like a black crow.
A child (子) who is a man (男): a boy. 男 is field (田) plus power (力).
Cow (牛) milk (乳): milk.
Eat (食べ) things (物): food.
着 means to arrive or to wear. "Tsuku": the train arrives at the station.
Fire (火) day (曜日): Tuesday, named after the fire planet Mars.
生 (life, a young one) plus 徒 (follower): a young follower who learns, a pupil.
The week (週) before (先): last week.
楽 means fun or ease (also in 音楽, music). "Tanoshii": fun times!
飲 has food (食) on the left plus 欠 (open mouth): to drink. "Nomu nomu" as you gulp.
早 is the sun (日) just over the horizon (十): early morning, early.
九 is nine. "Kyuu" sounds like the letter Q: Q is nine.
九 (nine) read く: used in 九時 (9 o'clock) and 九月 (September).
This (今) morning (朝): this morning. Special reading けさ.
住 is a person (亻) plus master (主): the person who is master of a house lives there.
The month (月) before (先): last month.
Ground (地) drawing (図): a map. Read ち here, not じ.
冷 has ice (冫) on the left: cold to touch. "Tsumetai" like ice in a drink.
Every (毎) year (年): yearly. Both まいねん and まいとし are fine.
庭 has a roof part (广): the open ground by a house, a garden. "Niwa" for nice flowers.
六 looks like a little person with a hat and two legs. "Roku": six rocks.
甘 is a mouth holding something (the line inside) to taste: sweet. "Amai": "ah, my!" so sweet.
重 means heavy (also in 体重, body weight). "Omoi": "oh, my!" this bag is heavy.
玄 (deep, dark) plus 関 (gate, barrier): the gate area where you take off shoes, the entrance.
違 has the road part (辶): going a different way, so different or wrong. "Chigau": nope!
Drink (飲み) things (物): drinks.
乗 means to ride or get on. "Noru": "no room" on the train, but you get on anyway.
Half (半) part (分): half.
Mail (郵便) office (局): the post office.
妹 is woman (女) plus not yet (未): a girl not yet grown, your younger sister.
鍵 has metal (金) on the left: a metal key. "Kagi": the key goes "ka-gi" in the lock.
靴 has leather (革) on the left: leather shoes. "Kutsu": put your shoes on.
冬 has two ice drops (⺀) at the bottom: the icy season, winter. "Fuyu": "phew, cold!"
切 (cut) plus 符 (tag, sign): a tag cut and stamped at the gate, a ticket.
月 (moon, month) read がつ for names of months: 一月 is January.
入 means to enter: make something enter, to put it in.
菓 has grass (艹) and fruit (果): long ago sweets were fruit. お菓子 are sweets.
閉 is a door (門) with a bar (才) inside: shut it. You close (しめる) something yourself.
番 (number in order, turn) plus 号 (sign, number): a number.
短 has an arrow (矢) on the left: an arrow is short. "Mijikai": too short.
嫌 is the same kanji as in 嫌い (dislike). "Iya!" is what you shout: no, I hate it!
屋 means house or roof: a shop. 本屋 is a book shop, パン屋 a bakery.
歩 is stop or foot (止) over a second foot: one foot after the other, walking.
遠 has the road part (辶): a long road, far. "Tooi": so far you need two (too) days.
封 (seal) plus 筒 (tube, case): a sealed paper case, an envelope.
語 has words (言) on the left: words, language. 日本語 is Japanese.
教 means teach (also in 教室, classroom). "Oshieru": she shows you how.
風 is wind: steam blows like wind off a hot bath. お風呂 is the bath.
背 is flesh (月) under 北 (two people back to back): your back, then your height. "Sei".
飛 (fly) + 行 (go) + 機 (machine): a machine that goes flying, an airplane.
向 means to face: the place you face, over there on the other side.
肉 is a picture of meat with lines of fat. "Niku": meat.
横 has tree (木) on the left: a tree branch goes out sideways. "Yoko" is the side.
開 shows two doors (門) opening. あく: the door opens by itself (no object).
危 shows a person crouching on a cliff edge: dangerous! "Abunai!" means look out!
辛 is a needle for punishment: painful, so spicy hot. "Karai": like hot curry.
帽 has cloth (巾) on the left: a cloth cover for the head, a hat.
秋 is rice plant (禾) plus fire (火): fields burn red and gold at harvest, autumn.
起 has run (走) on the left: you jump up and get going, to get up.
暗 has the sun (日) on the left plus sound (音): you hear but can't see the sun, dark.
This (今) evening (晩): tonight. こんばんは means good evening.
Make (作) writing (文): an essay or composition.
雑 (mixed, all sorts) plus 誌 (record, magazine): a book of mixed stories, a magazine.
狭 means narrow. "Semai": "say, my!" this room is so small.
茶 (tea) plus 碗 (bowl, with stone 石): a tea bowl, now the rice bowl.
始 has woman (女) on the left: life begins with a woman, so to begin.
Every (毎) month (月): monthly. Both まいつき and まいげつ are used.
見 means to see: make someone see something, to show it.
Both (両) parents (親): your mother and father.
時間 is time (時) span (間): 二時間 is two hours of time. 二時 is just two o'clock.
橋 has tree (木) on the left: a wooden bridge. Careful: 箸 (chopsticks) is also はし.
置 has a net (罒) on top: put it down and leave it there. "Oku": put it, OK?
This (今) month (月).
This (今) week (週).
砂 (sand) plus 糖 (sugar): sugar looks like white sand. "Satou".
少 means few or a little (also in 少し). "Sukunai": not many.
Built (建て) thing (物): a building.
広 is a roof part (广) over a wide open space: wide, spacious. "Hiroi": a huge room.
文 (writing) plus 章 (section, chapter): a piece of writing, a sentence or text.
千 is ten (十) with a stroke on top: thousand. "Sen": a thousand cents.
右 is a hand over a mouth (口): the hand you eat with, the right. "Migi".
度 means degree or times: 三度 is three times, or 3 degrees.
熱 has fire (灬) at the bottom: hot to touch, also fever (熱). "Atsui": ouch, hot!
腹 has flesh (月) on the left: a body part, the stomach. Polite お plus なか (inside).
知 is arrow (矢) plus mouth (口): words as fast and sure as an arrow, to know.
速 has the road part (辶): moving fast on the road. Not 早い (early).
待 has a street (彳) plus temple (寺): wait in the street by the temple. "Matsu".
三 (three) plus つ: three things. Say みっつ, like 三日 みっか.
皆 means all: everyone, said politely with さん.
北 is two people sitting back to back: they turn their backs on the cold north.
姉 has woman (女) on the left: the woman who came first, your older sister. "Ane".
Outside (外) country (国) person (人): a foreigner.
切 (cut) plus 手: a small cut piece of paper you stick on letters, a stamp. Sound change: きって.
Older brother (兄) plus younger brother (弟): brothers and sisters.
切 has a knife (刀) on the right: to cut. "Kiru": the knife kills the string.
果 (fruit) plus 物 (thing): fruit. Special reading くだもの.
黒 (black, soot over fire) plus い makes the adjective: black, dark.
Red (紅) tea (茶): Japanese call black tea red tea, from its color.
立 is a person standing on the ground with arms out: to stand. "Tatsu".
Tea (茶) color (色): brown, the color of tea.
晴 is the sun (日) in a blue (青) sky: to clear up, to be sunny.
Two (二) days (日), or the 2nd of the month. Special reading ふつか.
留 (stay) + 学 (study) + 生 (student): a student who stays abroad to study.
卵 looks like two eggs side by side. "Tamago": egg.
鳥 is a picture of a bird with feet (灬) at the bottom: bird, and chicken meat.
番 means number in order: 一番 is number one, the best.
皿 is a picture of a plate or dish seen from the side. Polite お.
遅 has the road part (辶): slow on the road, so late. "Osoi".
覚 has see (見) at the bottom: what you see, you remember. "Oboeru".
返 has the road part (辶): send it back on the road, to return it. "Kaesu".
Yellow (黄) color (色): yellow. 黄 read き here.
万 means ten thousand. "Man": a rich man has 万 yen.
耳 is a picture of an ear. "Mimi": "me, me", I can hear you.
四 is four: count four things and shout 'Yo!' (よ), よっつ.
塩 is salt: 'Show (しお) me the salt,' you say at dinner.
歯 is tooth: say 'Ha!' (は) and show your teeth.
戸 is a door: knock on the door with your toe (と).
明 joins sun (日) and moon (月): with both shining, everything is bright.
Enter (入) + mouth (口): the mouth of a building you go into, the entrance.
歌 means song: 歌う is to sing a song.
兄 is a big mouth (口) on legs (儿): the big brother who talks the most.
Water (氵) + forever (永): you swim in the water for ages.
Floor (階) + step (段): the steps between floors, the stairs.
借 has person (亻): you borrow from a person and 'carry' (かり) it home.
涼 has water (氵): water nearby makes the air cool and fresh.
座 shows two people (人人) on the ground (土) under a roof (广): sitting down.
頼 means rely on: you ask a favour of someone you rely on.
走 is ground (土) over a foot: feet hitting the ground, to run.
低 means low: a person (亻) bending down low, short.
細 has thread (糸): as thin and fine as a thread.
Eye (眼) + mirror (鏡): mirror glass for your eyes, glasses (special reading めがね).
Tree (木) + day of the week (曜日): Thursday is tree day.
持 has hand (扌): what your hand holds, you carry and own.
角 is a horn or angle: a corner sticks out like a horn.
暇 has sun (日): sunny days with nothing to do, free time.
椅 has wood (木): a wooden seat; 'ease' (いす) yourself into the chair.
五 is five: 'It's (いつ) five!' as you count five things.
登 means climb: shout 'No, bro!' (のぼる) as your friend climbs the mountain.
門 looks like two swinging doors: a gate; 'Come on (もん) in!'
分 means divide: when you can split a problem into parts, you understand it.
Gone (亡) + heart (心): it has left your heart and mind, you forget.
暖 has sun (日): sunshine makes the day warm.
生 means life or birth: 生まれる is coming into life, to be born.
Face (面) + white (白): a face lit up bright with fun, interesting.
Consume (喫) + tea (茶) + shop (店): a shop where you drink tea, a café.
着 means wear: 着る is to put clothes on your body. Not 切る (cut), same sound.
Take turns (交) + watch duty (番): police take turns keeping watch at the police box.
困 is a tree (木) trapped in a box (囗): stuck, you are in trouble.
出 means go out: 出かける is to head out of the house.
Ten (十) + day (日): ten toes, とおか, the 10th day.
弾 has bow (弓): pluck strings like a bowstring to play an instrument.
欲 means desire: what you desire, you want.
Book (本) + shelf (棚): a bookshelf.
回 is a box turning in a box: each turn round is one time.
緑 has thread (糸): thread dyed green like leaves.
遊 has the moving road part (辶): going out to wander and play.
House (家) + garden (庭): your house and garden, home and family.
軽 has car (車): a light car is easy to push.
咲 has mouth (口): the flower opens like a smiling mouth, it blooms.
撮 has hand (扌): your hand holds the camera to take a photo.
西 is west: 'nishi' sounds like 'nice sea' where the sun sets in the west.
脱 has the body part (月, flesh): take clothes off your body.
円 means circle: coins are round, so money is counted in circles, yen.
左 is a hand holding a tool (工): the hand that holds still, the left.
台 means stand or platform: machines and cars stand on one, so they use 台.
上 means up: 上げる is to raise something up.
洗 has water (氵): you wash things with water.
Project (映) + picture (画) + building (館): a building showing moving pictures, cinema.
押 has hand (扌): push with your hand; 'Oh, sue!' (おす) pushes the button.
姉 is woman (女) + market (市): big sister goes to the market alone.
Eat (食) + hall (堂): a hall for eating, the cafeteria.
Time (時) + repeat mark (々): time and time again, sometimes.
Two (二) + ten (十) + years old (歳): special reading はたち, 'hat, chi!' at 20.
One (一) + moon (月): one moon cycle, one month (not January いちがつ).
六 is six: six cows say 'Moo!' (むっつ).
弱 is two bent bows (弓): worn out and weak.
渡 has water (氵): pass things across the water, hand them over.
池 has water (氵): a small body of water, a pond.
歳 means age or year: it counts how many years old you are.
Five (五) + day (日): like 五つ いつつ, five starts with いつ, いつか.
Yellow (黄) + colour (色): yellow coloured.
消 has water (氵): water puts out a fire, it disappears.
Shoe (靴) + under (下): what goes under your shoes, socks.
閉 is a gate (門) with a bar (才) inside: shut tight, closed.
Go out (出) + mouth (口): the opening you go out from, the exit.
Chicken (鶏) + meat (肉): chicken meat; 鶏 has bird (鳥) in it.
Previous (昨) + night (夜): last night, read ゆうべ (also さくや).
Four (四) + day (日): like よっつ, four starts with よ, よっか.
呼 has mouth (口): use your mouth to call someone.
枚 has tree (木): paper comes from wood, so flat sheets use 枚.
階 means floor of a building: count floors with 階.
厚 has a cliff (厂): as thick as a cliff wall.
薄 has grass (艹) and water (氵): thin like grass, weak like watery tea.
売 means sell: 'Ooh, roo!' (うる) cries the stall man as he sells; opposite of 買う (buy).
Lead (鉛) + brush (筆): a writing tool with lead, a pencil.
貸 has shell (貝, old money): when you lend, your 'cash' (かす) goes out.
Sun (日) over cloud (雲): the sun hidden by clouds, cloudy weather.
消 has water (氵): pour water to put out a fire, so erase or switch off.
死 is a bone (歹) next to a fallen person (匕): to die.
止 means stop: 止まる is to come to a stop, like the 止まれ sign.
Two (二) + ten (十) + day (日): special reading はつか, 'hat car' day, the 20th.
引 is a bow (弓) and its string (丨): pull the string, to pull.
Eight (八) + hundred (百) + shop (屋): a shop with 800 kinds of food, the greengrocer.
Evening (夕) + meal (飯): the evening meal, dinner.
Ocean, Western (洋) + clothes (服): clothes from across the ocean, Western clothes.
廊 has a roof (广): a long roofed walkway, the corridor.
Week (週) + span of time (間): a span of weeks.
鼻 has 自 (self, first a picture of a nose) on top: the nose.
辺 has the road part (辶): the places around the road, the area nearby.
明 as in 明日 (tomorrow) + after (後) + day (日): the day after tomorrow.
Colour (色) + repeat mark (々): many colours, various.
Top (上) + wear (着): what you wear on top, a jacket.
Hand (手) + wash (洗い): the place to wash your hands, the toilet.
降 means come down: step down off the bus or train.
か + month (月): ～か月 counts months, 一か月 is one month.
Flower (花) + jar (瓶): a jar for flowers, a vase.
汚 has water (氵): dirty water, filthy.
Tie (結) + build (構): well tied and well built, so it is fine, enough.
Cross (交) + point (点): the point where roads cross each other, the intersection.
Self (自) + move (動) + vehicle (車): a vehicle that moves by itself, a car.
Big (大) + envoy (使) + building (館): the ambassador's building, an embassy.
疲 has the sickness part (疒): so tired you feel sick.
勤 has power (力): put your strength into working for a company.
飛 looks like a bird spreading its wings: to fly.
Mouth (口) + bird (鳥): a bird's mouth making sounds, an animal's cry.
Seven (七) + day (日): なな becomes なの, なのか, the 7th.
習 has wings (羽): a baby bird practising with its wings, learning.
貼 has shell (貝, old money): stick a paid stamp onto a letter, to paste.
冊 looks like bamboo strips tied together, an old book: so it counts books.
南 is south: 'Me, Nami (みなみ)' goes south to the warm beach.
側 has person (亻): the side a person stands on.
杯 has wood (木): cups were wooden, so cupfuls use 杯.
要 means need or key point: what you need.
Beautiful (美) + taste (味): a beautiful taste, delicious.
Big (大) + force (勢): a big force of people, a crowd.
One (一) + previous (昨) + day (日): one day before yesterday.
Piece (片) + borrowed (仮) + name (名): letters borrowed from pieces of kanji.
Can (可) + love (愛): easy to love, cute.
Cow (牛) + meat (肉): beef.
Warn (警) + official (官): the official who warns people, a police officer.
Nine (九) + day (日): like ここのつ, nine starts with ここの, ここのか.
九 is nine: 'Coco, no!' (ここの) you say nine times.
答 has bamboo (竹) + fit (合): a fitting reply written on bamboo, an answer.
さ + next year (来年, 来 means come): the year after next.
Character (字) + pull (引): you pull characters out of it, a dictionary.
Sauce (醤) + oil (油): dark, oily looking sauce, soy sauce.
吸 has mouth (口): suck air in through your mouth.
Stone (石) + lye (鹸): a stone like block made with lye, soap.
Back (背) + wide (広): a jacket with a wide back, a men's suit.
Step (段) + repeat mark (々): step by step, gradually.
Ground (地) + under (下) + iron (鉄): iron rails under the ground, the subway.
七 is seven: Nana (なな) has seven cats.
並 shows people standing side by side: line things up.
Ash (灰) + plate (皿): a plate for ash, an ashtray.
Leaf (葉) + write (書): a leaf of paper to write on, a postcard.
匹 counts small animals: a puppy 'he kicks' (ひき); watch いっぴき, さんびき.
Flat, plain (平) + borrowed (仮) + name (名): plain, rounded letters.
吹 has mouth (口): blow with your mouth, like the wind blows.
Pig (豚) + meat (肉): pork; 豚 is flesh (月) + pig (豕).
太 is big (大) with an extra dot: even bigger, fat and thick.
Ten thousand (万) + years (年) + brush (筆): a pen that lasts forever, a fountain pen.
磨 has stone (石): rub on a stone to polish.
Six (六) + day (日): like むっつ, six starts with む, むいか.
八 is eight: 'Yatta!' (やった) you got eight, やっつ.
Eight (八) + day (日): ようか; do not mix it up with 四日 よっか (4th).
渡 has water (氵): go across the water, to cross.
個 has person (亻): each single one, used for small items.
箸 has bamboo (竹): chopsticks are made of bamboo.
飴 has food (飠): a sweet food, candy; same sound as 雨 (rain).
零 has rain (雨): one drop of rain is almost nothing, zero.
Morning (朝) + polite (御) + meal (飯): the morning meal, breakfast.
足 pictures a leg and foot; 脚 has flesh (月): the leg.
浴 has water (氵): pour water over yourself, take a shower.
余 means extra: too much left over; with a negative, not very.
在 has earth (土): something sitting on the ground, it exists.
有 is a hand holding meat (月): something in your hand, you have it.
居 means live, stay: someone staying there, is present.
Elder (伯) or younger (叔) + father (父): a parent's older or younger brother, uncle.
Elder (伯) or younger (叔) + mother (母): a parent's older or younger sister, aunt.
終 has thread (糸): you reach the end of the thread, finish.
掛 has hand (扌): hang things up or put glasses on with your hand.
川 is three flowing lines, a river; 河 has water (氵), a big river.
Fine silk (綺) + lovely (麗): pretty and clean.
下 means down: hand it down to me, please.
Sun (日) over cloud (雲): clouds cover the sun, it gets cloudy.
Polite (御) + cooked rice (飯): rice, a meal.
差す means to hold up: hold up (差す) an umbrella over your head, or raise your hand.
締 has thread (糸): pull a thread tight, fasten.
Marsh (沢) + mountain (山): a mountain's worth, lots.
Many (多) + part (分): the larger part of chances, probably.
丁 (even, exact) + degree (度): to the exact degree, just right.
無 means nothing: make something into nothing, lose it.
並 shows two people standing side by side: line up.
温 has water (氵): water only a little warm, lukewarm.
初 is clothes (衤) + knife (刀): the first cut when making clothes, the beginning.
Evening (晩) + meal (御飯): dinner.
Noon (昼) + meal (御飯): lunch.
曲 means bend or curve: bend round the corner, turn.
丸 and 円 both mean circle: round.
易 means easy: simple; do not mix it up with 優しい (kind).
